function.description: Place an order for food delivery on Uber Eats by specifying the restaurant and the items with their respective quantities. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

items.description: A list of food item names selected for the order.

I don’t have access to live weather feeds, so I can’t give you the exact current temperature in Moscow right now.

* Weather.com / AccuWeather  
* The official Russian Meteorological Service (Gismeteo)  
* A weather app on your phone (e.g., Apple Weather, Google Weather)

These sources will provide the current temperature in Celsius along with humidity, wind speed, and forecast details.
